tasks.label: Jekyll: Install Prerequisites
tasks.command: $rubyBin = $null; $rubyCmd = Get-Command ruby -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($rubyCmd) { $rubyBin = Split-Path $rubyCmd.Source -Parent }; if (-not $rubyBin) { $candidate = Get-ChildItem 'C:\Ruby*' -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $candidate) { $candidate = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Ruby" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 }; if ($candidate) { $rubyBin = Join-Path $candidate.FullName 'bin' } }; if (-not $rubyBin) { winget install --id RubyInstallerTeam.RubyWithDevKit.3.4 --exact --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements; $candidate = Get-ChildItem 'C:\Ruby*' -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $candidate) { $candidate = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Ruby" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 }; if ($candidate) { $rubyBin = Join-Path $candidate.FullName 'bin' } }; if (-not $rubyBin -or -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $rubyBin 'gem.cmd'))) { Write-Host 'Ruby not found after install. Restart VS Code and rerun this task.'; exit 1 }; $env:Path = $rubyBin + ';' + $env:Path; gem install bundler jekyll

tasks.label: Jekyll: Preview Site
tasks.command: $rubyBin = $null; $rubyCmd = Get-Command ruby -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($rubyCmd) { $rubyBin = Split-Path $rubyCmd.Source -Parent }; if (-not $rubyBin) { $candidate = Get-ChildItem 'C:\Ruby*' -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $candidate) { $candidate = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Ruby" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 }; if ($candidate) { $rubyBin = Join-Path $candidate.FullName 'bin' } }; if ($rubyBin) { $env:Path = $rubyBin + ';' + $env:Path }; $jekyll = Get-Command jekyll -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($jekyll) { jekyll serve --livereload } else { Write-Host 'Jekyll not found. Run task: Jekyll: Install Prerequisites'; exit 1 }
